messages.Pentru \\(n\\) vectori se aplică repetat: For \(n\) vectors, apply the triangle rule repeatedly: place each vector's origin at the tip of the previous one.
messages.Rezultanta închide linia poligonală: por: The resultant closes the polygonal chain: it starts at the first vector's origin and ends at the last vector's tip.
messages.\\[ \\vec R = \\sum_{k=1}^{n}\\vec F_k,: \[ \vec R = \sum_{k=1}^{n}\vec F_k, \qquad R_x = \sum F_{kx},\quad R_y=\sum F_{ky} \]
messages.Ordinea în care sunt așezați vectorii nu: The order of the vectors does not matter — the polygon changes but the resultant stays the same.
messages.Dacă poligonul forțelor se închide, \\(\: If the force polygon closes, \(\vec R = \vec 0\): by Newton's first law, the particle stays at rest or in uniform rectilinear motion. The equilibrium condition is \(\sum \vec F_k = \vec 0\), or \(\sum F_{kx}=0\) and \(\sum F_{ky}=0\).
messages.pe figură: ultima forță devine exact opu: on the figure: the last force becomes exactly opposite to the sum of the others and closes the polygon.
messages.vectori se aplică repetat regula triungh: vectors, apply the triangle rule repeatedly: place each vector's origin at the tip of the previous one.
